newsitem.title: UK: Ladbroke to take 15 mln stg charge for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ladbroke to take 15 mln stg charge for 1996.

text.p: British hotel and betting company Ladbroke Group Plc said on Monday that its results for the year to December 31, 1996 will include an exceptional charge of 15.4 million stg.
The charge relates to a 10 million stg payment Ladbroke will make to UK supermarket group J Sainsbury Plc following a review of the price it sold do-it-yourself retailer Texas Homecare Ltd for.
Ladbroke sold the the Texas Homecare business in March 1995 for a provisional price of 290 million stg.
The purchase price included an estimated net asset value of 155 million stg, which was subject to adjustment on finalisation of completion accounts.
In the absence of an agreement, the matter was referred to an independent expert who ruled that there is a balance in favour of Sainburys.

"We are pleased with the outcome of the determination in that Sainsburys were asking for considerably more in terms of a repayment. It is a fairly minimal adjustment to the basic consideration," a Ladbroke spokesman told Reuters.
